question: Does Portillo et al. (2017) provide locality-resolved fish evidence for Norzagaray River, and is it the 2016 multi-species assessment compared by the AWTIP EPRMP?

source.citation: Portillo, J. N., Patulili, R. R., Lucas, M. M. A., Alaijos, O., & Demayo, C. G. (2017). Body Shape Variation in the Goby, Glossogobius giuris Collected in Selected Areas in the River of Norzagaray Bulacan Using Landmark-Based Geometric Morphometrics. Journal of Informatics and Mathematical Sciences, 9(4), 1109–1116. https://doi.org/10.26713/jims.v9i4.1021.
source.accessNote: Publisher article page and publisher-hosted full-text PDF were reviewed. The PDF identifies the article as open access under a Creative Commons Attribution License; the publisher page calls this CCAL and does not specify a version in the reviewed text. No local copy was retained.

studyScope.dateLimit: The article reports received and acceptance dates in 2016 and publication in 2017, but gives no fish-collection date. Editorial dates are not used as occurrence dates.
studyScope.stationCoordinateStatus: Methods say stations were GPS-determined, but no numeric coordinates were present in the reviewed station table/text. The map was not visually inspected or digitized; no geometry was added.
studyScope.featureIdentityLimit: Retain the article's Norzagaray River name and Barangay Matictic context. Do not automatically merge this local feature name with Angat River or another reservoir/river identity without an independent feature crosswalk.

methodsAndTaxonEvidence.methodAsReported: Five stations were sampled using backpack electrofishing to stun fish before capture with fishing nets. The article says specimens were preserved and identified/authenticated by BFAR Region III.

taxonomicCrossCheck.finding: The Catalog lists Glossogobius giuris (Hamilton, 1822) as valid. This is a nomenclatural check only and does not re-identify the paper's specimens.
taxonomicCrossCheck.complexCaveat: Use the source-reported identification and keep specimen-level uncertainty visible because no voucher/catalogue identifiers or retained specimen records were located in the article.

methodsAndTaxonEvidence.arithmeticCheck: The five station row totals sum to 116; male and female column totals sum to 59 and 57 respectively. This is the morphometric study sample, not an abundance estimate, catch rate, full fish-community inventory, or population census.
methodsAndTaxonEvidence.dietDisposition: The introduction repeats generalized diet information citing FishBase; no local stomach-content or diet analysis was conducted. No Bangwit diet or bait claim was taken from this paper.

relationshipToAwtip2016Comparison.awtipClaim: The AWTIP EPRMP compares a 2016 survey at 12 sites with a 2022 four-site survey and states 17 versus five taxa; its indexed comparison table contains 15 taxon rows.
relationshipToAwtip2016Comparison.crosswalkAssessment: Portillo et al. is a 2017 single-species morphometric study at five named Norzagaray River stations, with editorial receipt/acceptance in 2016 but no collection date. It could overlap or be a subset of the EPRMP's 2016 field work, but no shared station list, methods lineage, dates, author/report cross-reference, or specimen links establish that relationship. It is not the 17-taxon list and cannot resolve its 15-versus-17 row-count discrepancy.
relationshipToAwtip2016Comparison.disposition: Keep the 2017 article as a distinct source and the AWTIP comparison as unresolved. Do not combine sample totals or treat the sources as independent confirmations until survey lineage is established.

rightsAndPublication.licenseAsReported: Creative Commons Attribution License (CCAL), publisher page version unspecified; PDF front matter states that sharing is permitted with acknowledgement of authorship and first publication.
rightsAndPublication.decision: The source's minimal station-count data may be summarized with full citation and attribution in this research artifact. No article photograph, table image, map, or other media was copied. No app-facing occurrence row or image was added.

nextActions: Seek the exact 2016 AWTIP comparison source or its field annexes through other public sources; keep the 2017 morphometric study separate unless a source-matched lineage is established.
Search for the five stations' numeric GPS coordinates and any catalogue/voucher record without converting the article map into geometry by guesswork.
Continue Central Luzon freshwater and other habitat-lane reviews; this one-species sample does not complete Norzagaray River, Angat/Ipo/Bustos, Bulacan, or the region.

sources.supports: Publisher metadata, authors, abstract, publication date, license statement, and article citation.
Publisher-hosted full text: five-station methods, Table 1 station counts, BFAR identification/authentication description, and CC Attribution notice.
Current Catalog of Fishes nomenclatural status for Glossogobius giuris; not specimen identity.
Separate AWTIP source's indexed 2016/2022 comparison claims; it does not identify Portillo et al. as the underlying 2016 survey.
